exchanges: ok so i finally made it to halifax. boxes everywhere lol
Congrats on making it! Unpacking is the worst part, but it gets better once the kitchen's sorted.
yeah the kitchen is a disaster. my roommate jonah already claimed the good shelf
Classic roommate move. Is he someone you knew before, or new to you?
new, found him online. hes nice tho. he does accounting at the college, same campus as me
That's handy, you can share the commute. How are you feeling about starting classes?
nervous. nursing program starts monday
That's a big program, being nervous makes sense. The first weeks are usually orientation-heavy, which helps.
met the neighbour today, priya. she has the cutest beagle, he ran right up to me
A friendly dog next door is a great welcome. Did you get to chat with her much?
a bit, shes a paramedic actually!! said she can give me tips for clinicals
That's a lucky connection to have right next door. Someone with real field experience can be a big help.
funny thing my cousin is also named priya. back home in brampton. she has a dachshund lol so now i have two priyas with two little dogs
That's going to make for some confusing stories! At least the dogs are different enough to tell apart.
lol true. ok need to find a doctor here, the waitlist thing is insane
Family doctor waitlists in Nova Scotia can be long. Walk-in clinics can cover you while you wait.
update i got lucky?? a clinic near campus had a spot. dr okafor. first appt next week
That's great news, getting a family doctor that fast is rare. Is it just a general intake visit?
yeah intake plus i need my immunization records for the program
Smart to sort that early, those programs are strict about records. Bring whatever you have from back home.
also my tooth has been killing me. booked a dentist, dr lindqvist, on the same street lol
Getting both sorted in one area is efficient. Hope the tooth isn't anything serious.
probably a filling. anyway first day of class was today
How did it go? First days can be a lot of names and syllabi.
good! sat next to this guy tomasz, super chill
Nice, it helps to have a friendly face in class. Is he in your program too?
no hes just in my english elective. he's doing welding, wants to work at the shipyard
That's a solid trade, especially in a port city. Electives are a good way to meet people outside your program.
omg i was wrong about the neighbours dog. its a basset hound not a beagle, priya laughed at me when i said it
Easy mix-up, they look similar with those ears. At least she found it funny.
jonah wants to get a cat now. i said ask the landlord first
Good call, a lot of leases have pet clauses. Does the landlord seem reasonable?
her name is gloria, shes like 70 and very strict about noise
Sounds like a cat might be easier to sell her on than a party then.
lol. my aunt mei called, she wants to visit in october
That's nice to have family coming out. Will she stay with you or nearby?
hotel thank god, our place is tiny. shes bringing me my winter coat
Very practical of her. Halifax winters are damp and windy, you'll want it.
had a study group tonight, there was this girl amara whos also in nursing
Study groups are a good way to get through the heavy courses. Did it go well?
yeah she used to be a dental hygienist before switching, so she knows a ton of anatomy already
That background must give her a head start. She sounds like a good study partner.
for sure. we're meeting again thursday at the library
Having a regular time will help a lot once exams start.

my family doctor here is dr okafor right?
what did amara do before nursing
what does aunt mei do for work
